en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Whoa, this is a huge dojo...
The tatami mats are new. They smell nice...
Nyeeeh...what a pain...

There's no mana here...
This is not my kind of place...
M-My back hurts...

If you do that again...
I'll definitely turn you into a gross frog...

But right now...I have to use all my magic 
to fix my back...
See, this *is* my lab, you jerk!
Wh-Why are you *angry*?

I'm so happy, I just can't contain my emotions!
Like an excited dog that just pees everywhere!

<CLT=cltMIND>An emotional rollercoaster...
The complete opposite of Himiko.

Wow, this is such a nice dojo! I'm sure
sparring will be incredible here!
But, without a sparring partner—
HAIYAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*slam!*
AAUGH! Wh-What was that for!?

Ow! Ow! Owww!
Wh-Why are you throwing me?

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> is a super serious martial art!
Instead of training, we just fight head-on!
Now, Himiko! Aim for the heart!
You're going to *start* with that!?
Hahaha! I'm just kidding!

*This* is just kidding?
Why did we go straight into actual fighting—

You don't have a lot of confidence in
yourself, do you, Shuichi?
...What?

You lack self-esteem...and because of that,
you doubt your strength.

You seem more confident than before, but
I can tell you still question yourself.

...Well!? I'm right, aren't I!? I can tell when
my sparring partner is burdened by doubt!
...You might be right.

You know what works real good at lifting
all that doubt!? <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Because Aikido itself is a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Japanese martial art<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
that treasures a pure heart above all else!
So, how about you, Himiko?
Nyeh?

If we combine your magic with my Neo-Aikido,
then we'd be able to solve things by force!

<CLT=cltMIND>By force? I thought this was
about being pure of heart...

Nyeeeh...I don't wanna do any exercise.
It's too much of a—
HAIYAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!
Nyeeeeeeeehhh...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*slam!*

I see... It seems you are still too shy
to show your emotions, Himiko.

What a waste. You have the richest heart
of all.

You should do <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Himiko! Training
your body will help you express your emotions.

Now, come sweat with me! And afterward,
we'll hit the showers together!
Nyeeeh... M-My back...

I feel like...turning you into a gross frog 
with my magic right now...
Oh...you're angry. I can see it in your heart.
Even I can see that...
I will tell you the secret of Aikido.

Aikido is not about competing for fun to see
each other's strengths and weaknesses.

By working together and using techniques that
make full use of your mind, body, and breath...

...you can measure your physical and mental
growth. That is the true purpose of Aikido.

You do not compete for superiority in Aikido.
In fact, in Aikido you do not compete at all.

Aikido is not a martial art for inflicting harm,
but a way to improve yourself!
What do you think? Pretty amazing, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>That sounds like a good creed,
but I still got thrown...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large doll made of wood...
Ah, wait...*is* it a doll?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this supposed to watch over us
and protect us?

<CLT=cltMIND>The tatami mats are new.
They smell nice...
<CLT=cltMIND>Neon Sign

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this...a pillar?
Why is there a pillar here?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a scaffold suspended in
the air with chains.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this for some kind of jump training?
It's like a kung-fu movie...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this...a pillar?
Why is there a pillar here?
